title: Same profile as a clean fit, but net debt at 3.9x EBITDA

input.facts: Immunoassay analyzers with a captive reagent business: reagents and service are 70% of sales. Net debt rose to 3.9x EBITDA after a debt-financed acquisition closed last year; management guides deleveraging to 3x within 18 months. The share price fell 29% after a one-off inventory write-down linked to the integration. No shareholder above 25%. No regulatory issue.

why: 3.9x is below the 4x kill line: elevated leverage is not a kill criterion until it crosses the threshold written in the thesis. Everything else fits.
